CXSCA_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional Checkmarx SCA project id (UUID) to scope the import. When set, only that project's most recent scan is imported via /api/projects/{id} + /api/projects/{id}/scans (with /api/scans?projectId=<id> as a fallback for older CxSCA builds). Omit to enumerate every project visible to the access token and import each project's latest scan.

CXSCA_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Enforced client-side after severity normalisation (handles Checkmarx SCA's string severities — CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE — and CVSS v3 numeric scores). Default: info.

name: checkmarx_sca
title: Checkmarx SCA
description: Checkmarx SCA (standalone CxSCA) REST API importer. Pulls Software Composition Analysis findings from a Checkmarx SCA tenant and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Lists projects via /api/projects (or fetches a single project via /api/projects/{id} when CXSCA_PROJECT_ID is set), resolves each project's most recent scan via /api/projects/{id}/scans (with /api/scans?projectId=<id> as a fallback for older CxSCA builds — preferring scans with status done/completed/success and falling back to the most recent of any status), then pulls per-scan vulnerabilities via /api/scans/{id}/vulnerabilities. Each project becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 because SCA findings live in dependency manifests, not on IPs); per-scan vulnerabilities are attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per CxSCA vulnerability id with [SCA] engine prefix, CVE list, package@version, ecosystem, fixed_in version, CWE/advisory refs and similarityId enrichment in the description. Severity normalised from Checkmarx SCA's string severities (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE, also accepts informational/moderate/negligible) with CVSS v3 fallback when only a numeric score is given (read from cvss3.baseScore / cvssV3.baseScore / cvssScore / score); client-side min-severity floor enforced after normalisation. Status mapped from CxSCA's lifecycle status (new/recurrent/active → open, fixed/resolved → closed) combined with analyst state — NotExploitable / NOT_EXPLOITABLE / PROPOSED_NOT_EXPLOITABLE / SNOOZED become Faraday risk-accepted. Auth: static bearer token via CXSCA_ACCESS_TOKEN sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every API call. CXSCA_HOST is the Checkmarx SCA regional base URL (e.g. https://api-sca.checkmarx.net, https://eu.api-sca.checkmarx.net).
